ValidationRule.description: MR-119 1b.3: lines of a Voided, Accepted or Denied quote can't be added or changed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Quote.Status, "Voided"), ISPICKVAL(Quote.Status, "Accepted"), ISPICKVAL(Quote.Status, "Denied")), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Quantity), ISCHANGED(Discount), ISCHANGED(UnitPrice), ISCHANGED(Product2Id)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The quote is final (Voided, Accepted or Denied); its lines can't be changed. Clone the quote to make changes.
